findings_for_codex.title: Pre-funded request PDA blocks the draw until the deadline

evidence.label: financial.close.collision_with_preexisting_request_fails_closed_no_alternate_seed.prefunded_system_account.request
evidence.note: prefunded_system_account: the request FAILED CLOSED (the provider refuses a pre-funded PDA; a public-address griefing vector until the deadline) (a pre-funded empty system-owned account at the request PDA)

findings_for_codex.detail: The request PDA is derived from public inputs once the candidate set is sealed. The captured ORAO executable creates it with create_account, which fails (system Custom(0) AccountAlreadyInUse) when anyone has pre-funded the address; request_round_draw fails closed as designed (Collision / no alternate seed), so the promotion for that close can only expire Skipped(Deadline). Cost to a griefer on the cluster: the rent-exempt minimum for an empty account (890,880 lamports locally) per close, lost to the griefer; impact: that round's Series B promotion is skipped, the seed carries, every cash path (settlement, finalize, claims) completes, no lamports are lost by the project. The plan accepted fail-closed collisions; it did not price this vector.
options: accept and document (the promotion is a bonus draw, not owed cash; ~0.0009 SOL per grief)
ask ORAO whether request creation can tolerate a pre-funded PDA (upstream; not ours)
any seed-unpredictability change would reopen the accepted deterministic-seed design (not recommended here)
findings_for_codex.status: open for Codex; no code change made

findings_for_codex.title: capture_round_draw records IgnoredLate on an already-terminal close before the terminal check
findings_for_codex.detail: close.rs capture_round_draw: a late capture on a terminal close sets draw_state = IGNORED_LATE (a harmless field write) whereas a timely capture on a terminal close returns PromotionTerminal; ordering only, no cash or state of consequence.
findings_for_codex.status: open; fix proposed for the M8 program pass (reorder require_pending before the deadline branch)

findings_for_codex.title: Error codes LateCapture 6027 and CandidatesIncomplete 6047 are declared but never raised
findings_for_codex.detail: Late capture is the IgnoredLate no-op; incomplete candidates expire with STAGE_CANDIDATES_INCOMPLETE. Frozen codes stay reserved.

findings_for_codex.title: Treasury fee moves at request time, not at fulfillment
findings_for_codex.detail: Probe receipts and the suite: request: Client −(fee+rent), request account +rent, Treasury +fee; fulfillment: request −excess rent, Client +excess rent. The plan sketch said "Treasury +300,000 at fulfillment".
